items.text:
うんこをこまめに手入れすると、うんこ臭が少なくて済む。
Study point: The grammar pattern 〜にこだわる is used here to emphasize the importance of maintaining cleanliness.
English translation: Maintaining cleanliness by paying attention to details reduces unpleasant smells.
